sources.note: Founder decision G9-b (2026-11-07): Vast.ai asks may be shown as a current market reading in the offers table and as inputs to the regional pressure grid, labelled as such wherever they appear. The deployment that uses them is temporary and comes down after the hackathon.

sources.name: WRDS Compustat fundamentals quarterly
sources.licence: Licensed to the founder's institution for research; served to signed-in accounts only; removed after the hackathon
sources.attribution: Quarterly revenue, capital expenditure and total assets from Compustat via WRDS; research use under an institutional licence
sources.note: Founder decision G13 (2026-11-08), second extract: eight tickers, fiscal quarters 2018 to 2026 Q3, extracted by the founder under the institutional WRDS licence and loaded into the archive by product/flopx/tools/compustat_load.py from a secret file the deployment mounts (/etc/secrets/flopx-compustat.csv); the file is never committed. Stored per ticker as fundamental:<T>:revenue_q, fundamental:<T>:capex_q (the quarter's own spend, derived from Compustat's fiscal year-to-date capxy) and fundamental:<T>:total_assets, each at the fiscal period end with the report date in the note. Derived figures (revenue growth year on year, capex intensity) are public; the raw rows reach signed-in accounts only, and live SEC EDGAR facts win over Compustat wherever both report the same period. Changing this row's use to display-and-archive lifts the gate. The loader's delete mode removes every row when the project comes down.

sources.name: Alpaca Market Data (founder's account)
sources.licence: Alpaca Market Data under the founder's own account; personal and noncommercial use only; served to signed-in accounts only; removed after the hackathon
sources.attribution: Daily closes from Alpaca Market Data (IEX feed), adjusted for splits; personal and noncommercial use under Alpaca's terms
sources.note: Terms and Conditions read 2026-11-08: Content is provided exclusively for personal and noncommercial access and use, and no part of it may be copied, republished or publicly displayed to any other server or web site for publication, distribution or any commercial enterprise without Alpaca's written consent. So the 2026 daily bars (timeframe 1Day, split-adjusted, the IEX feed of the free Basic plan) for the eight tickers are loaded into the archive by product/flopx/tools/alpaca_load.py at startup and refreshed once a day, continuing the CRSP series past 2025-12-31; the raw points reach signed-in accounts only and derived results are public. Not display-and-archive because the terms do not permit showing the raw bars to anonymous readers. Changing this row's use lifts the gate. The loader's delete mode removes every row when the project comes down.

sources.name: GetDeploying GPU rental price history
sources.attribution: GetDeploying (2026). GPU rental price history [dataset], https://getdeploying.com/dataset/gpu-prices, licensed CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/); six models selected and relabelled with FLOPX model ids
sources.note: Dataset page read 2026-11-08: "Free with attribution, CC BY 4.0: Credit GetDeploying and link to the license"; the licence covers the published dataset files only (the site and its API stay under GetDeploying's terms), prices are estimates for information only, and the newest week can change until its Sunday has been captured. The weekly CSV (103 GPU models, 94 providers, 53 trailing weeks; the median, minimum and maximum of each week's daily captures of advertised asks per model and billing type) is loaded by product/flopx/tools/getdeploying_load.py at startup and once a week into gpu:<model>:getdeploying:weekly-median, :weekly-min and :weekly-max for the six FLOPX models (on-demand rows only; GetDeploying's family slugs pool boards, so nvidia-h100 stands for h100-sxm-80gb and nvidia-a100 for a100-sxm-80gb), each week stamped at its end and held back until then. A third-party history reference served beside FCPI through the series read; never written into index:fcpi:* or gpu:<model>:on-demand:*; the pressure engine's momentum factor reads the weekly median only while a model's own FLOPX index is younger than its 30-day window, labelled as GetDeploying's and never mixed with FLOPX points. The loader's delete mode removes every row.

sources.name: U.S. Energy Information Administration (EIA API v2, Form EIA-930)
sources.attribution: Hourly grid data from the U.S. Energy Information Administration (Form EIA-930), public domain
sources.note: Copyright page read 2026-11-08: U.S. government publications are in the public domain and EIA's data may be used and distributed; the exception it names is third-party material, which here means EIA's ICE wholesale price spreadsheet, not read. Dormant without EIA_API_KEY (the key travels only as the api_key query parameter and is never logged or stored). The API carries no wholesale price for any balancing authority (every /v2/electricity/ route listed 2026-11-08), so the series are hourly demand and the day-ahead demand forecast for ERCOT and PJM in MWh (energy:ERCOT:demand, energy:ERCOT:demand-forecast, energy:PJM:demand, energy:PJM:demand-forecast), never the energy:<zone>:day-ahead price the power-stress factor reads. The history backfill loads two years in 200-day chunks (4800 rows a request against a 5000-row cap).
